page_title: Pullo · Pull requests and CI in your Mac's notch

summary.name: Pullo
summary.one_liner: Pullo is a free, open source macOS app that shows your GitHub pull requests, CI results and Actions runs in the notch.
use_cases: Track your open pull requests and review requests at a glance
Get alerted when a CI run fails or passes
Rerun or cancel GitHub Actions jobs without opening a browser
Monitor deployments from the Mac notch
Switch between work and personal GitHub accounts in one list
summary.what_it_does: Pullo lists your GitHub pull requests and the ones waiting on your review, showing CI status, size and age for each. It drops down from the notch when a GitHub Actions run changes, showing the result for a few seconds. You can follow each job and step of a run, rerun failed jobs or cancel stuck ones from the notch. It supports sign-in with multiple GitHub accounts and keyboard navigation (arrows, ⌘F search, ⌘1 to ⌘9 tab switching). It calls the GitHub API directly from the Mac, borrowing the token from the gh CLI without storing it.
notable: Lives in the notch and drops down on CI or review changes
Borrows the token from GitHub CLI (gh) and never stores it; no server or sign-up
Supports multiple GitHub accounts with avatar labels per row
Keyboard navigation with arrows, ⌘F search and ⌘1 to ⌘9 tab switching
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later and Apple silicon, per the page
Requires the GitHub CLI (gh) to be installed and logged in for authentication
Works on Macs without a notch by using the top center of the menu bar instead
